in_sanskrit.name: Prabin
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Creatures
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Prabin एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Prabin is derived from the Sanskrit word Prabhāv, which means 'Lord of Creatures'. This name is often given to children as a mark of respect and reverence towards the divine creator of the universe.
